scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,UI,ELECTRON" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:ui" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=telemetry-contracts && npm run build --workspace=telemetry-api && npm run build --workspace=desktop-ui && npm run build --workspace=telemetry-electron
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=telemetry-contracts && npm run build --workspace=desktop-ui
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=telemetry-contracts && npm run build --workspace=telemetry-api
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=telemetry-contracts && tsc -b packages/contracts backend/api backend/electron
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=telemetry-api && npm run test --workspace=desktop-ui
